reviewer_statement: Developer-side source-semantic scientific review based on frozen Python 1.2, full mathematical outputs and row/field geometry, input/boundary cases and direct source-typed differential tests committed. Cross-platform and pinned-Python exact-head GitHub Actions remain queued; this is not independent scientific certification.
native_language_semantic_policy: Source mathematical result represented in native R scientific arrays/data.frames, with source-specific input mode where needed, not Python runtime object identity. Source-shaped result validation is not an assertion of upstream optimizer parity or Python exception class matching.

case_evidence.description: Published Python typed mixed-effects fitted source results for reference and comparison, declared maximum lag, labels and raw or whitened scale. Source-shaped R residual postfit scientific records are validated without model refitting.

Converged finite fitted source residual arrays with aligned curve, participant, response dimension, time unit and exactly matched irregular time grid; iid identity or fitted symmetric positive-definite serial residual correlation; mixed 3-curve repeated participant inputs.

Source centered within-trial autocovariance, normalized ACF, physical-lag min/mean/max, pair-weighted overall summaries, exact inner one-to-one merge keys and comparison minus reference deltas on raw or Cholesky-whitened residuals.

Nonconverged source fit, mismatched time/cohort/dimension/participant mapping, malformed residual covariance, zero covariance variance for source view, bad maximum lag and unrecognized residual scale fail closed.

Complete 20-column source comparison pandas table as native R data.frame: labels, six inner join keys, four reference and four comparison metrics, three signed delta columns, all in source column order.

Descriptive sensitivity of residual-dependence diagnostics between two predeclared fitted models, not an estimator reconstruction, covariance selection, goodness-of-fit ranking or automated hypothesis test.

independent_review_status: Provisional author-reviewed with exact SHA256 provenance, no independent certification; exact-head CI pending.
language_specific_limits: R consumes validated postfit source-shaped scientific records; it does not claim to reproduce Python's upstream MixedLM optimizer.
Python fitted dataclass identity and Python exception classes are not native R objects, and existing native mixed moments are separate estimators.
Comparison labels are validated native strings, and source output strings are retained; arbitrary non-string Python label coercion is not claimed.
